bugs.title: Vendor bill payment cannot record a transaction or cheque reference
steps: Sign in to Nexstock QA Company and open Bills (AP).
Create an isolated bill for QA P2 Vendor mvo2d41l with subtotal Rs 97, tax Rs 10 and a future due date.
Click Pay on that exact QA bill.
Select Bank Transfer or Cheque and inspect all payment inputs.
bugs.expected: The manual payment can retain its amount, payment date, method and transaction/cheque reference for reconciliation.
bugs.actual: Record Payment exposes Amount, Payment Date and Payment Method only. There is no reference or transaction field. The actual tested payment payloads include amount, paymentDate and paymentMethod, with no reference.
bugs.comment: Add reference entry/persistence and expose it in the bill payment/supplier ledger. The amount arithmetic and Cash/Bank Transfer/Cheque bookkeeping paths pass; this ticket concerns the missing required reference capability.
